name: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABHA)
description: Creates a digital health ecosystem: ABHA ID, Health ID, Personal Health Records (PHR), and interoperable health information exchange.
benefits: Single health ID to link records across providers; consent-based sharing; easier continuity of care.
required_documents: Aadhaar / Driving Licence / any govt ID for ABHA creation
application_mode: Online (abdm.gov.in / ABHA app) and via health facilities
application_steps: Authenticate with Aadhaar OTP or other ID.
Link PHR address and records from providers.

faq.a: No, it is voluntary; you can opt out.
Sharing is consent-based and governed by the ABDM data-sharing framework.

ai_summary: ABDM provides a voluntary ABHA health ID to link and consent-share medical records across providers.
ai_explanation: ABDM builds a digital health infrastructure where residents create an ABHA ID to consolidate health records and share them with providers on a consent basis. It is free and voluntary, improving continuity of care.
